question: I'm making a tutorial video of our login page (http://localhost:8092/enhanced-elements.html) with Doc Detective's `record` step. How do I turn on audio so a voice-over explaining the username field (`#username-input`) and then the submit button (`#submit-button`) ends up in the MP4? Show me the spec.

facts.text: Doc Detective recordings are video only, with no audio track; the `record` step has no option that captures sound.
To narrate in the video, use `annotate` steps inside the recording span; their annotations stay up across steps and navigation until cleared, so they appear in the recording.

must_not: The `record` step has an option (such as `audio`, `microphone`, `captureAudio`, or `voiceover`) that records sound into the video.
Annotations on a `screenshot` step (`screenshot.annotations`) appear in the recording.

run.does: that records the page and annotates #username-input during the recording

wrong.why: clicks an element the page lacks

wrong.answer: Set `audio: true` in the object form of `record`, and Doc Detective captures the system microphone into the MP4 alongside the video. Speak your voice-over while the test runs, or add `annotations` to a `screenshot` step to show captions in the video.
